status: AUTHOR DRAFT, NOT INDEPENDENT. Written by the same AI-assisted process that built FAIR, with knowledge of Prompt v5. It exists to test the scorer and to give an adjudicator something to compare with. Do not report results against it as independent. Reviewers must label from the inputs alone before seeing this file.
cost_rules: cost describes what the terms establish. total_12_months is the charge over the first 12 months, or null where no single total is established. one_time_fees lists amounts charged once.

accepted_evidence: billed annually as one payment of USD 96
annotations.rationale: One annual payment conflicts with paying each month and stopping after any month.
annotations.ambiguity: A system could treat USD 8 as the stated price; billing is annual either way.

accepted_evidence: Founding members keep USD 12/month for as long as their subscription stays active.
annotations.rationale: An explicit lasting promise. Tests that promise handling does not become over-caution.
annotations.ambiguity: Assumes the user is a founding member, which the belief does not state.

annotations.rationale: A reserved right to change prices at any time conflicts with cannot go up.
annotations.ambiguity: The 12-month total holds only if no price change happens.
